links.reported_relation: The module permits fees up to 500,000 (50%) while CLFactory.getSwapFee() rejects any fee above 100,000 (10%), so the system always falls back to basic tick spacing fees, rendering the dynamic fee mechanism ineffective.
Any dynamically calculated fee above 10% is rejected by the factory, so dynamically calculated fees are not applied and the 50% anti-MEV cap becomes unusable.
